title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Enrollment Terms Schedule
content:
The enrollment terms of Commercial Natural Gas Supply set which sites a plan serves, the band of historical gas usage a site must fall in, the channels through which a plan may be enrolled, whether a pending enrollment may be withdrawn before the gas utility confirms it, and when a drop takes effect.

## Site terms

| Plan | Premise class served | States offered | Minimum 12-month historical usage (therms) | Maximum 12-month historical usage (therms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | Commercial | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | 1200 | 250000 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | Commercial | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | 1200 | 250000 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | Commercial | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | 1200 | 250000 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | Commercial | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | 1200 | 250000 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | Commercial | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | 1200 | 250000 |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | Commercial | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | 1200 | 250000 |

## Channel, withdrawal and drop terms

| Plan | Enrollment channels | Withdrawal permitted before utility confirmation | When a drop takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index | Phone, web, broker | Yes | The next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed Basis 12 | Phone, web, broker | Yes | The next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 12 | Phone, web, broker | Yes | The next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 | Phone, web, broker | Yes | The next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 36 | Phone, web, broker | Yes | The next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Carbon Neutral 24 | Phone, web, broker | Yes | The next scheduled meter read |

## Notes

- The six plans share identical enrollment terms: commercial premises only, in Pennsylvania (PA), Ohio (OH), Illinois (IL), New Jersey (NJ) and Maryland (MD), with 12-month historical gas usage from 1200 therms up to 250000 therms.
- Every plan may be enrolled by phone, on the web or through a broker.
- Every plan permits withdrawal of a pending enrollment before the gas utility confirms it, and on every plan a drop takes effect on the next scheduled meter read.
